description:
Daily, monthly or annual values for one location and one or more variables, 1961 to the present.

    Monthly and annual values are free. Daily values cost 1 credit per day and variable and need the
    user's DailyMeteo API key or account (see the server instructions). Results include a summary per
    variable; series longer than 400 rows are not listed but summarised by year and saved as CSV.

confirm_credits.description: Set true only after the user agreed to a day request over 1000 credits
confirm_credits.title: Confirm Credits

dates.description: Individual dates instead of a range, same format
dates.title: Dates

save_csv.description: Save the table as CSV (long series are always saved)
save_csv.title: Save Csv

start.description: First date: YYYY-MM-DD (day), YYYY-MM (mon) or YYYY (ann); from 1961
start.title: Start

variables.description: One or more of tmean, tmax, tmin (°C), prcp (mm)
variables.title: Variables

name: get_weather
title: Weather values for a location
